fullPassage: People may not think critically for a variety of reasons, such as laziness and inability, but fear is a big one. Why is that? People don’t want to think not just because it’s hard, but also because they’re afraid it will make them question their long-held beliefs. Your students most likely do want to think about things that can be very controversial, like politics, ethics, and philosophy. But probe even deeper. Once we start thinking deeply, long-held assumptions are challenged. Thought makes us worry that we’ll lose our balance and have to look at the world in a different way. We worry about thinking because we care about what we and other people think. Even the most far-fetched ideas have an effect on the world. Non-Euclidean geometry and symbolic logic are about as abstract as thinking can get, but you can’t understand Einsteinian gravity without the first and run computers without the second. Thinking is important to us, to others, and to the world we live in. This is one reason why we are so afraid of it: it shakes us to the core.

questions.passage: People may not think critically for a variety of reasons, such as laziness and inability, but fear is a big one. Why is that? People don’t want to think not just because it’s hard, but also because they’re afraid it will make them question their long-held beliefs. Your students most likely do want to think about things that can be very controversial, like politics, ethics, and philosophy. But probe even deeper. Once we start thinking deeply, long-held assumptions are challenged. Thought makes us worry that we’ll lose our balance and have to look at the world in a different way. We worry about thinking because we care about what we and other people think. Even the most far-fetched ideas have an effect on the world. Non-Euclidean geometry and __________ logic are about as abstract as thinking can get, but you can’t understand Einsteinian gravity without the first and run computers without the second. Thinking is important to us, to others, and to the world we live in. This is one reason why we are so afraid of it: it shakes us to the core.
questions.stem: 윗글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 비유클리드 기하학과 기호(symbolic) 논리학이 가장 추상적인 사고입니다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ symbolic
❌ ② practical
❌ ③ simple
❌ ① natural
✅ symbolic(기호적인): 기호 논리학으로 원문과 일치
❌ practical(실용적인): 추상적이라는 맥락과 반대
❌ simple(단순한): 기호 논리학의 성격과 다름
❌ natural(자연적인): 논리학 유형과 맞지 않음
det.tip: symbolic logic = 기호 논리학 (수학적 기호를 사용하는 논리학)

questions.passage: People may not think critically for a variety of reasons, such as laziness and <u>inability</u>, but fear is a big one. Why is that? People don’t want to think not just because it’s hard, but also because they’re afraid it will make them question their long-held beliefs. Your students most likely do want to think about things that can be very controversial, like politics, ethics, and philosophy. But probe even deeper. Once we start thinking deeply, long-held assumptions are challenged. Thought makes us worry that we’ll lose our balance and have to look at the world in a different way. We worry about thinking because we care about what we and other people think. Even the most far-fetched ideas have an effect on the world. Non-Euclidean geometry and symbolic logic are about as abstract as thinking can get, but you can’t understand Einsteinian gravity without the first and run computers without the second. Thinking is important to us, to others, and to the world we live in. This is one reason why we are so afraid of it: it shakes us to the core.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 inability와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 무능력(inability)이 비판적 사고를 방해합니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① weakness
❌ ③ limitation
✅ ② capability
❌ ④ deficiency
✅ capability(능력): inability의 반의어
❌ weakness(약점): inability의 유의어
❌ limitation(한계): inability의 유의어
❌ deficiency(결핍): inability의 유의어

det.korean: 기호 논리학 없이는 컴퓨터(computers)를 작동시킬 수 없습니다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① telescopes
✅ ② computers
❌ ③ vehicles
❌ ④ clocks
✅ computers(컴퓨터): 기호 논리학이 필요한 대상으로 적절
❌ telescopes(망원경): 기호 논리학과 무관
❌ vehicles(탈것): 기호 논리학과 무관
❌ clocks(시계): 기호 논리학과 직접 관련 없음
det.tip: computers — 기호 논리학(symbolic logic)의 실제 적용
